page.notes: Stray vertical marks at the column edges (after "mor-" and "potuisse") are scan artefacts, not print. The word "istic" is read from a slightly blurred line; "salutares" has a Cyrillic-looking "a" in the scan and is written as "saluta-" with the Latin a read as printed. Index entry numbers are copied as printed, including the errors in the entry for "Christum" under "Argumenta Orthodoxorum", which is printed as "Christum, si homo".
